prompts.yellow:
Use case: concept-art. Create ONE high resolution landscape 3D artist vehicle turnaround reference sheet for CAR STARS, based on the supplied concept images. Reference images define vehicle identity and chunky stylized low-poly matte miniature-game art direction, NOT layout. Plain warm off-white background, very clean studio lighting, crisp edges, no scenery, no UI, no smoke, no motion, no depth-of-field, no photorealism, no logos, no weapons, no damage.
Layout: clean 4 columns by 2 rows, eight complete uncropped render views of the SAME SINGLE vehicle, with generous whitespace and understated small English labels. Top row: FRONT, REAR, LEFT, RIGHT. Bottom row: TOP, UNDERSIDE, FRONT 3/4, REAR 3/4. First six views strictly orthographic, no perspective; final two explanatory elevated three-quarter views. Side views same scale and wheel baseline, front/rear same width, top consistent length/width. Four wheels total, same exact wheelbase, cabin position, body width, door count, bumpers, lamps, colors and trim in ALL views. Both side views show the corresponding actual side, opposite facing directions. Top and underside nose point upward. Underside simple dark flat game chassis with two axles, no elaborate engine/realistic mechanical greebles. Identity and consistency matter more than decoration. No dimension numbers or false engineering specifications. Single modest header and small labels only.
YELLOW GETAWAY SEDAN. Match the large yellow car in first reference: boxy compact four-door sedan, straight long flat hood, short stepped trunk, angular trapezoidal cabin, golden yellow paint, opaque navy glass, dark grey rocker panels and thick grey rectangular bumpers, square pale cream headlights with thin amber surrounds, black narrow horizontal grille, black simple tires, flat light-grey hubcaps. NO spoiler, NO taxi sign, NO roof beacon. Rear has two simple rectangular red tail lights and dark numberplate recess. Preserve toy-like chunky proportions rather than modern aerodynamic styling. Header: YELLOW GETAWAY.
